Habrá gel hidroalcohólico a disposición de todos los participantes en todas las mesas de competición, tanto como en la entrada y salida del edificio. Los asientos serán nominativos, por lo tanto, cada competidor permanecerá sentado en ellas si no está compitiendo. El resto de asientos se podrán ocupar hasta completar aforo. Wearing a mask is compulsory during all the competition. There will be hand sanitizer available for the use of the competitors at the competition tables, such as at the entrance and exit of the building. The seats will be nominative, so while not competing, the competitors must remain seated at their designated place. The rest of the seats may be taken up to the maximum capacity of the venue. items.information: **PLEASE NOTE:** This is a Blindfolded & Fewest Moves specialist competition. There will be no regular speedsolving events held. The winner of 5x5 Blindfolded will be announced as the winner of the competition. **ALL** competitors must read the **COVID-19** tab to make sure that they are aware of the differences to prior competitions in the UK. venue.name: 2do Nivel (zona recreativa)
venue.address: Av Ramon Vargas Machuca 306, San Juan de Miraflores 15801

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Esta competencia será patrocinada por la marca internacional de cubos Moyu, por la tienda peruana The Cube Girls y por la marca de ropa Laobek´s. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. Obligatoriamente es necesario asistir al torneo con mascarilla puesta. **ENGLISH** This competition will be sponsored by the international cube brand Moyu, by the Peruvian store The Cube Girls and by the clothing brand Laobek's. The results of this tournament will enter the database and the WCA ranking, and those who participate for the first time will acquire an official profile. For this reason, all competitors must be aware of the WCA regulations. It is mandatory to attend the tournament wearing a mask.

items.name: Northern Colorado Cubing 2022
items.information: There is no mask policy at the venue, but we still strongly recommend that you wear a mask during the competition. There is no strict no food/drink policy, but during lunchtime if you bring food into the venue, we ask that you eat at tables right outside the back doors. We will remind about this during the competition. This competition will be following unique precautions to protect competitors and spectators against COVID-19. We kindly ask you to read the Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab before registering. The competitor limit for this competition is 60 competitors. Competitors are being asked to bring two spectators maximum to the competition, and if possible, to attend alone.

items.name: SSN Cube Open 2022

venue.name: [SSN Engineering college](https://www.ssn.edu.in/)
venue.address: SSN Engineering college, SH 49A, Kalavakkam, Tamil Nadu 603110

items.information: ## Registration for this competition has been closed as the competitor limit has been reached. * Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. All participants are expected to volunteer for the event when they are not participating. The roles could be of a judge, runner, or a scrambler, depending upon the situation. COVID-19 Specific Information: * We will be requiring proof of a negative COVID-19 RTPCR test within 72 hours before the start of competition (or) proof of full vaccination (two doses) to enter the competition. * Participants of age less than 18 (non-vaccinated) should bring RT-PCR report which was taken within 72 hours before the start of competition. Failing to submit the proof, Organizing team can deny entry to such participant to the competition. No refund will be allowed in that case. * We strongly discourage you from bringing guests. The maximum number of guests that is preferred to accompay a competitor would be limited to ONE. The Guest must bring proof of a negative COVID-19 RTPCR test within 72 hours before the start of competition (or) proof of full vaccination (two doses) * Any spectator will require to submit a proof of a negative COVID-19 RTPCR test within 72 hours before the start of competition (or) proof of full vaccination (two doses) * Wearing masks, Sanitizing hands frequently and following all local goverment orders is mandatory while attending the competition.
